summary: Independent verification of FIEZEL backend patches (anti-IDOR guards, B7 note fix, N+1 refactor, per-teacher demo bootstrap). Ran all four suites requested by the main agent AND authored 15 new independent edge-case tests focusing on cases the review-note flagged: owner bypass, 404-vs-403 semantics, empty class (0 students) + zero-evidence class regression after N+1 refactor, assessment for_whole_class vs explicit student_ids targeting, blueprint scoping, B7 field completeness + invariants, and full session start→next→answer round-trip. Everything is green.
coverage_added_this_iteration: 404 (not 403) for non-existent class_id and assessment_id on GET /api/classes/{id}, /api/coverage, /api/braincore/recommendations, /api/assessments/{id}, /api/assessments/{id}/analytics.
Coverage + recommendations + tp-detail on ZERO-student class do not error (N+1 refactor regression).
Coverage on class with roster but ZERO evidence: students_total>=2, students_mastered==0, mastery_pct is None/0 (BKT posterior average semantics confirmed — not mastered/exposed ratio).
Lesson-plan blocks minutes sum to requested minutes (within ±5 slack).
Two teachers each bootstrap: each owns its own demo class, first teacher does NOT lose its class (teacher_id stays), demo codes differ when FZ-DEMO7A already exists, roster is 18.
Assessment with explicit student_ids: for_whole_class=false, only target listed.
Assessment without student_ids: for_whole_class defaults to true.

B7 fields present on every coverage row: students_total, students_exposed, students_mastered, students_developing, students_needs_help, mastery_pct. Invariant mastered<=exposed<=total holds. GAP note contains 'dari' and 'yang aktif'. MISSING rows have exposed=0 and mastered=0.
End-to-end learner session: start(200) → next(200 with question) → answer(200 with learner_state).
critical_code_review_comments: assessment.py list_assessments (line ~349-354) correctly ORs {student_ids: user_id} with {for_whole_class: true, class_id: $in class_ids}. This is the right shape and matches the review request — explicit targeting takes precedence and whole-class fallback is scoped to enrolled classes. Verified via TestAssessmentTargeting.

braincore.py _coverage_row (line ~424) computes mastery_pct as average posterior mastery across exposed students, not (mastered/exposed). This is coherent with BKT semantics but the naming 'mastery_pct' can be misread. Consider renaming to 'avg_posterior_pct' or adding a doc comment; not a bug, purely clarity.
GAP note format 'N dari M yang aktif' is stable and testable (TestB7Fields asserts substring). Good.
kelasku tickets one-shot (jti burned) is verified idempotent; second use → 401. Solid.
Owner role short-circuits at access.py helpers (assert_class_teacher / assert_class_member) and at list_blueprints. Cross-verified via TestOwnerBypass.

Bootstrap demo picks alt code (FZ-DEMOxxxx) when FZ-DEMO7A occupied — confirmed. Second teacher no longer steals first teacher's demo class (main P2 fix). teacher_id integrity preserved on subsequent /api/classes reads.

N+1 refactor: coverage on class with zero students returns 200 with empty stats (all zeros); on class with roster but zero evidence returns 200 with students_mastered=0 and mastery_pct None/0. No exception, no divide-by-zero. Solid.
Latency ~45ms/request on --reload workers is uvicorn reload overhead as noted — not investigated further.
test_credentials: No static creds. Local tickets minted with CURRICULUM_TICKET_KEY from /app/backend/.env via kelasku.sign_ticket. See /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Each bootstrap-related test calls POST /api/seed/bootstrap under a fresh teacher ticket; produces one demo class + 18 students + evidence per teacher.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend patches (P0 IDOR guards, P0 B7 note, P1 BKT parity, P2 N+1 refactor + per-teacher demo bootstrap) are all green under 121 independent assertions. Question objects returned by /api/learning/sessions/{id}/next use key 'question_id' (not 'id') — tests updated accordingly. 'mastery_pct' in coverage rows is BKT posterior average, NOT mastered/exposed ratio; don't assert the latter identity. Owner bypasses class scoping in access.py. When a class has zero exposed students, mastery_pct is None (not 0) — accept both.
rca of the issue: N/A this iteration — no bugs found. Two initial test-script mistakes on my end (missing 'title' on BlueprintIn, wrong mastery_pct semantics) were fixed in the test file; not backend defects.
